about: The offertorium of the formulary “20th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

s01.translation: By the streams of Babylon we sat and wept when we remembered you, O Sion.

w003.gloss: Babylonian, of Babylon (city on Euphrates, capital of Babylonia)

w004.gloss: in that place, there, over there
